evals.prompt: Draft a GitHub issue for fictional acme/billing using the supplied repository context; do not contact any service, create files, or publish. The default branch's applicable invoice bug form requires sections 'Observed result', 'Expected result', and 'Release', the marker <!-- billing-intake -->, the existing label billing-bug, and a checkbox 'I reproduced this myself'. The owner's public .github repository has a generic template, but this repository has its own form. Since v2.3, clicking Save twice quickly creates two invoices; customer support reported it with an admin account in Chrome. I have not reproduced it personally. No assignee, priority convention, or estimate is established. Return the title, body, metadata proposals, and any publication blockers.
evals.expected_output: Uses the repository form rather than an inherited or generic template, preserving its required sections, release, and marker. Keeps billing-bug as metadata, does not falsely check personal reproduction, and distinguishes the reported duplicate-invoice behavior from unknown cause and unestablished metadata. Returns a draft without external effects.
assertions: Uses Observed result, Expected result, and Release rather than replacing the repository form with a generic or inherited template
Preserves v2.3 and the <!-- billing-intake --> marker in the body and billing-bug as metadata
Does not mark personal reproduction confirmed and identifies the required checkbox as unresolved before publication
Does not invent an assignee, priority convention, estimate, or root cause
Does not publish, contact external services, or claim that an issue was created

evals.prompt: Draft an update to fictional Linear issue CAL-42 in the Scheduling workspace, Calendar team. Use only these supplied facts; do not contact services, create files, or publish. CAL-42 accepts February 30 in the booking form and fails only after submission; the outcome is to reject impossible dates before booking. The explicitly selected applicable team template 'Calendar defect' requires sections 'Customer effect' and 'Acceptance' and defaults to existing label calendar-bug, priority Medium, and project Booking reliability. Estimates are disabled. The current issue's assignee is Mina (user-17), it is a child of CAL-10, and it blocks CAL-50. The workspace's generic template has different headings and no team label. A suggested implementation is a new date helper, but no approach is agreed. Return the updated title/body and intended metadata and relationships.
evals.expected_output: Uses the selected team template and its established properties without replacing them with the workspace generic template. Preserves the current assignee and both relationships. Keeps estimates unset and states the desired behavior without making the tentative date helper a requirement. Returns an unposted update draft.
assertions: Uses Customer effect and Acceptance and describes rejecting impossible booking dates
Retains calendar-bug, Medium, and Booking reliability as established template metadata rather than inventing replacements
Preserves Mina (user-17), parent CAL-10, and the blocking relation to CAL-50
Leaves estimates unset without enabling them or assigning zero
Does not make the tentative date helper a required implementation or publish the draft
